svg.title: Evidence and publication status map for eight pid-rs mathematical result families
svg.desc: A matrix lists eight mathematical result families in order. Separate columns identify analytic results, scoped formal subclaims, bounded executable evidence, and report or integration status. Rows one through four have detailed scoped reports and PDFs. Row five has three distinct evidence layers and multiple PDFs, while its certifier is conditional and integration remains open. Row six has an integrated scoped Markdown report and PDF, while the full certificate remains open. Row seven has a canonical Markdown report while its dedicated PDF remains open. Row eight has a scoped arithmetic core marked GO while repository and publication integration remain NO-GO and its dedicated result PDF remains open.

g.text: Completion is stated per row; proximity is not proof transfer.
exact scope named in every row
Formal subclaims, exact arithmetic, bounded corpora, report PDFs, and integration gates remain separate evidence objects.
